name: Mariyatsu Harumi
source:
Hajime's senpai and the president of the handicrafts club. Even though she is the president, she doesn't actually make crafts. Since she likes interesting things, she became the president just for fun. Because she goes overseas all year round, although her grades are excellent, she doesn't often show up for class or the club. Furthermore, she keeps her souvenirs scattered around the club room. Though she seems to be irresponsible, she will sometimes make sharp remarks. Her breasts are small in proportion to her height and she has a complex about it. She is the only part-time employee at Mana.

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/タペストリー_-you_will_meet_yourself-]Wikipedia[/url]]
